 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Parwej Khan, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Akbar Ali, APP

= =====================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 4 21-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint case no. 137 of 2021 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323/504 of the Indian Penal Code .
Both the parties are physically present.

It is submitted on behalf of the parties that dispute has been amicably settled and wish to live together and lead a happy conjugal life Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances as Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.41938 of 2022(4) dt.21-03-2023 well as submissions of the parties

, this anticipatory bail petition is allowed and it is ordered that petitioner,
in the event of his arrest/ surrender within four weeks from the date of receipt of this order to the court concerned, shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs 10,000/- (ten thousand)
each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate- IV, Kaimur at Bhabhua in Complaint Case No. 137 of 2021 subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
